scope: Cluster bank generation, transfer integrity and two-row local numerical portability; no inference or market-adequacy acceptance.

accounting.timestamp_scope: Raw scheduler timestamps; timezone not supplied by the accounting export.
accounting.cpu_cost_scope: Sum of parent-task elapsed wall seconds times allocated CPUs; allocated CPU time, not measured utilized CPU time. Steps are not double-counted.
accounting.rss_scope: Maximum batch-step MaxRSS, scheduler K/M/G units interpreted as powers of 1024; not sum of simultaneous memory.

roles.context: known synthetic contracts/spot/rates/quote sigma; model_context also known; stored in configuration
roles.example_id: auxiliary split-qualified base-panel identity; future augmentations must keep base grouping
roles.parameters: ordered synthetic training targets only; never observed conditioning
roles.pricing_covariance: auxiliary covariance of MC price MEANS; zero for Fourier
roles.pricing_standard_errors: auxiliary MC standard errors (zero for deterministic Fourier)
roles.reference_prices: auxiliary numerical expectation estimates, not exact market truth
roles.refinement_difference: auxiliary refined-minus-base Fourier estimate; MC zeros mean not calculated

local_replay.scope: One seeded training row per bank; portability tolerance check, not all-row replay or inference validation.
